$what: Provenance of the OWNED donor fixture test/fixtures/donors/aeon-root/games/sonic4/data/donors/s2disasm/FXZ/: a synthetic converted donor zone (our own six tiles and pattern, no donor bytes) in the exact tree and zone.json shape aeon tools/s2_zone_convert.py writes. Generated by scripts/gen-donor-fixture.mjs, which computes every count and sha256 in its zone.json from the bytes it writes.
$why_owned_and_not_vendored: There is no revision at which a real donor tree exists: games/sonic4/data/donors/ is gitignored and derived in aeon (docs/reviews/2026-09-17-s2-donor-page-read-half-settled.md). So the behaviour rows run on this owned tree, hermetic under npm test, and two other legs carry what it cannot: the CURRENCY row (test/formats/donor-fixture-currency.test.ts) holds its SHAPE to the converter aeon publishes, and the fidelity rig (test/live/donor-fidelity.test.ts, opt-in) runs the real converter.
$what_the_shape_pin_means: real_key_paths is the key-path set of zone.json as a REAL run of the converter wrote it: measured on all six owner zones (s2disasm EHZ CPZ MTZ OOZ WFZ, s2-simonwai-disasm HPZ), converted 2026-09-25 in an archive copy of aeon at the revision below, and all six carried the SAME set. A path ending [] is a key of every object in that array. The currency row compares the converter file at aeon origin/master against converter_blob: a changed converter is a possibly changed shape, and the row goes red naming both blobs and how to re-measure.

aeon.revision_is: aeon origin/master after a fetch on 2026-09-25, the tree the six real zones were converted from (an archive of that revision, never the live working tree)

re_measure: materialise aeon at origin/master as an archive into a scratch dir, run python3 tools/s2_zone_convert.py convert --all-six there with EMPYREAN_SUITE_ROOT set, take the key-path set of each zone.json (objects recursed, arrays of objects as []), update real_key_paths, converter_blob and both revisions here, then re-run node scripts/gen-donor-fixture.mjs if the set moved.
